entities.summary: Trevor J-Daniel Rogers is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Baltimore Orioles of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Miami Marlins. Rogers was selected 13th overall by the Marlins in the 2017 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut with them in 2020.
